# CrickFrenzy

CrickFrenzy is a professional, high-precision batting simulation game built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. The gameplay focuses on millisecond-level precision timing, shot selection (off-side, straight, on-side), and facing diverse bowling types.

## Game Modes
- **Quick Play / Practice**: Select team, match length (1, 2, 5 overs), difficulty (Casual, Pro, Champion), and play a standalone chase.
- **World Cup Tournament**: Complete 20-nation tournament with Group Stages, Super Eight, Semifinals, and Grand Finals, featuring Net Run Rate (NRR) and detailed tournament tables.
- **Indian Cricket League (ICL)**: 10-team league with 9 round-robin matches per team, Playoffs (Qualifier 1, Eliminator, Qualifier 2), and Grand Finals.

## Controls
- **Swing**: Space or Enter
- **Direction**: A/ArrowLeft (Off-side), W/ArrowUp (Straight), D/ArrowRight (On-side)
- **Next ball**: Space (when ball is dead)

## Routes
- `/`: Main Home Screen (menu navigation)
- `/play`: Quick Play Match Setup & Playing modes
- `/world-cup`: World Cup Tournament Hub & Match progression
- `/ipl`: Franchise T20 League Hub & Match progression
